state.title: How the model answers
state.body: The model returns a probability for a yes/no question, a distribution over a closed set of named options for a choice question, and an ordered level for a score question. Each answer is typed, so code can gate on it without parsing prose. The three primitives cover every question we have found in nine repositories, and every pack composes them in code rather than asking the model to combine them.
state.deck_purpose: Introduce JEV to a business audience in 12 minutes

state.title: Calibration and the review queue and what you commit to
state.body: Out-of-the-box calibration is not trusted. Every decision you make on mail or code becomes a labeled row. The review queue shows the mid band first. Thresholds are fitted on a time split and frozen. Drift re-runs frozen fixtures weekly.
